tooltips.kind: How this row was sourced: 'native' mirrors a row from Chatwoot's `reporting_events` table 1:1; 'synthetic' is generated from `conversations.created_at` (Chatwoot does not emit a real `conversation_created` event — `conversation_opened` only fires on reopens).
tooltips.eventName: Lifecycle event name. `conversation_created` (synthetic) and `conversation_opened` (reopen) are status transitions into the open state; `conversation_resolved` is a transition out. `first_response` is the agent's first reply; `reply_time` is recorded on every agent reply.
tooltips.tenant: Denormalized tenant of the event's parent ChatwootAccount. Set automatically; used for per-tenant reports and ACL-free aggregations.
tooltips.happenedAt: Wall-clock time the event occurred (Chatwoot's `reporting_events.created_at`, or `conversations.created_at` for synthetic rows).
tooltips.eventStartTime: Window start time, populated by Chatwoot for `first_response` / `reply_time` events. Null for status transitions.
tooltips.eventEndTime: Window end time, populated by Chatwoot for `first_response` / `reply_time` events. Null for status transitions.
tooltips.valueSeconds: Chatwoot's `value` column in seconds. Meaningful for `first_response` (time-to-first-response) and `reply_time` (per-reply latency). Null for status transitions.
tooltips.valueInBusinessHoursSeconds: Same as `valueSeconds` but only counts business-hour seconds, per the account's business-hours configuration.
tooltips.chatwootInboxId: The originating Chatwoot inbox numeric id.
tooltips.chatwootUserId: The agent user id that triggered the event (Chatwoot internal numeric id; may be null for system events).
tooltips.chatwootConversationId: Chatwoot conversation display_id (per-account human-friendly id). Same id used in conversation URLs.
tooltips.chatwootReportingEventId: Source row id from Chatwoot's `reporting_events` Postgres table. Null for synthetic rows.
